descriptions.en: Grants a 1.33x|1.66x|2x multiplier to all Heavy Ammo Meter progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
20 Direct Hits on a target within 1 second of each other applies [Strand]Sever for 10 seconds (15 seconds with [Strand]Thread of Continuity) and grants you [Strand]Woven Mail for 10 seconds.

Grants 20% Damage Resistance while overcharging a [Void]Void Grenade with [Void]Chaos Accelerant.
Overcharged Grenade Hits apply [Void]Weaken for 6 seconds and grant additional base grenade Regeneration Rate depending on the equipped grenade for 1.75 seconds.
• Axion: [pve]5000% [pvp][4000%]
• Scatter: [pve]3700% [pvp][2700%]
• Vortex: [pve]3400% [pvp][2400%]
• Handheld Supernova: [pve]2500% [pvp][2000%]
4 second cooldown between activations, which is removed on grenade usage. Grants between 50-60% Grenade energy per activation.
[Void]Vortex Grenades can proc twice if enemies get hit by the initial explosion and the last few ticks.

Class Ability usage collects certain pickups within 12.5|18.5 meters with 1|2+ Mods equipped.
Applicable pickups:
• Orbs of Power
• Motes of Light in Gambit
• Crests in Supremacy
• Data Motes in Episode: Echoes activities
Passively increases Stability by 20 but decreases Reload Speed by 20.

Weapon Kills grant 1 Stack of Adrenaline Junkie for 4.5 seconds. Grenade Kills grant all 5 Stacks instantly even if the weapon is stowed.
Adrenaline Junkie benefits:
• 20 Handling
• 6.7%|13.3%|20%|26.6%|33.3% increased damage at 1|2|3|4|5 Stacks

Increases Kinetic Weapon damage while you have active Armor Charges:
[pve]• PVE: 10%|17%|22%|25% increased damage with 1|2|3|4 Mods
[pvp]• PVP: 3%|4.5%|5.5%|6% increased damage
The 4th tier of the damage buff is only obtainable through Artifact Perks and Exotic Armor.
Armor Charge now decays over time at the rate of 1 every 10 seconds by default.

While within 15 meters of an ally:
Grants a stack of Nano-Munitions every 3 seconds. Maximum of 7 stacks.
Emptying this weapon's magazine consumes a stack to refill 25% of your magazine (rounded up). Consuming a stack restarts the timer for gaining new stacks.
Emptying the magazine of any other weapon consumes all stacks, with each stack refilling 25% of your Magazine (rounded up). Holding a weapon with an empty magazine also consumes these stacks.
Heat weapons confuse the perk in unexpected and inconsistent ways, and all stacks may be consumed at random while using one.

Aiming Down Sights for [enh]1.4 seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for [primary]Scout Rifles, 30% for [heavy]Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)
Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.
For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% [pvp][35%] damage bonus.
[enh] Activation time is decreased by 0.1 seconds.
Gain 15 Handling, 15 Reload Speed, and 2 Aim Assist for each stack of Gathering Light.

Converts this weapon's element into [Strand]Strand damage.
Kills with Grenade Chaser grenades spawn a [Strand]Tangle.

Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Grants the following benefits to you and allies within the rift:
• [pve]20% [pvp][15%] Increased Damage ([Empowering Buff](https://url.d2clarity.com/DamageBuffs))
• [pve]260% [pvp][104%] Additional Base Grenade and Melee Regeneration Rate
• [pve]230% [pvp][92%] Additional Base Class Regeneration Rate
• Kills generate 15% Increased Ammo Meter Progress

Only usable while on the ground. Movement speed is slowed by 50% during the cast animation.
Grants 20% Damage Resistance during the cast animation. Rift lasts 15 seconds and has a 5 meter radius.
Heals you and allies in the Rift for [pve]40 [pvp][35] HP per second.
If at full health, the Rift grants 3 HP of Overshield per second, up to a 15 HP Overshield.
Standing in a friendly Healing Rift makes the game count you as having an active Overshield at all times.
Reloading loads 1 additional round into the magazine at a time.
Dealing damage grants 'Scientific Method' for 5 seconds, granting 35 Handling and maximized Movement Speed. Buff cannot be refreshed.
Well-rounded, reliable, fires a 3-round burst.

Weapon Kills grant Stacks of Sword Logic.
The number of Stacks and the buff duration are tied to the highest [Enemy Rank](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants) killed since activation:
• Minors: 1 Stack for 5.5 seconds
• Elites, Players: 2 Stacks for 7.5 seconds
• Players in their Super and Minibosses: 3 Stacks for 10.5 seconds
• Bosses: 4 Stacks for 15.5 seconds
Damage increase at 1|2|3|4 Stacks:
15% | [pve]25% [pvp][15%] | 35% | 50%
Additional Kills refresh the buff duration to the duration tied to the highest Enemy Rank killed.

Counts as a "Dealer's Choice" origin trait weapon, but does not benefit from the trait itself.
Every 7th shot in the magazine deals [pve]252.52% [pvp][5%] increased damage, has 50% increased Auto Aim cone size, and ricochets to the nearest target within an [pve]8 [pvp][5] meter radius.

[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds of using your Class Ability spawns an Orb of Power that grants 0.8%|1.1%|1.25%|1.5% Super Energy with 1|2|3|4 Mods equipped. (4 Mods is only achievable through Exotic Armor)
10|5|1|1? second cooldown between activations with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Grants the following benefits for your first shot (of the burst):
• 20 Aim Assist and 25 Range
• 5% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Growth
[special]Special weapons only receive 50% of the benefits. Stats are rounded up.
Firing the weapon prevents the perk from activating for 3 seconds.
Breaking a Combatant Shield with the matching Elemental Damage Type grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

Passively increases Zoom by 1.
Increasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Increased Magnification
• Increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Decreased Absolute Recoil
• Narrowed Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

Only works in PvE game modes.
Ammo Brick pickups generally grant 1 additional ammo to [Solar]Solar Weapons matching the Ammo Type.
Machine Guns receive 7 additional ammo, Trace Rifles receive 10% of their Total Reserves (rounded up) as additional ammo.
Functions the same way regardless of what spawned the Ammo Brick.
Context: normal Ammo Bricks grant 25-33% of your Total Reserves by default.

Finishing a reload picks up all Ammo Bricks within 15 meters.
Also works on Motes and Crests.

Class Ability usage refills ?% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your Super Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on [primary]Primary, 15% on [special]Special).
[enh] Passively grants 5 Handling.

Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more. [pvp]On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[pve][PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.
[pvp][PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
[enh] Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.

Refills 5% of the magazine (rounded up) every 1.5 seconds while [Arc]Amplified.
Activating [Arc]Speed Booster increases this rate to once every 0.25 seconds, and allows the perk to overfill the magazine up to double its base capacity.
[enh] Passively grants 15 Magazine stat. (Equivalent of 50% of Backup Mag's Magazine stat benefit)

Dealing damage grants 15 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
Scoring a Weapon Kill increases this to 30 Airborne Effectiveness and ?% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Weapon damage refreshes buff duration.

Finishers trigger an Elemental explosion that deals up to 135 Super-Matching Elemental Damage and applies a Super-Matching Elemental Debuff in a ? meter radius.
Elemental Debuffs applied:
• [Arc]Arc: [Arc]Jolt
• [Solar]Solar: x40 [Solar]Scorch
• [Void]Void: [Void]Volatile
• [Stasis]Stasis: x? [Stasis]Slow for ? seconds
• [Strand]Strand: [Strand]Sever for ? seconds

When the magazine has at least 1 round loaded, Glaive Melee Attacks deal 50% increased damage and apply [Stasis]40 Slow for [pve]4 [pvp][1.5] seconds ([pve]8 [pvp][1.5] with [Stasis]Whisper of Durance).
[Bosses](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants) only receive 20% increased damage.

Grants 10% increased damage to marked targets. [Minibosses and Bosses](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants) only receive 5% more damage.
Hits against marked Minors and Elites|Minibosses and Bosses have an 85%|25% chance to refund one ammo into the magazine.

Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

Scoring multiple Hits on targets Exhausts them. Triggering it on Players makes them deal 10% less damage.
Exhaust duration cannot be refreshed.
Hit Requirements by Weapon Type:
• 3 Hits: Bows, Glaives (both Projectile and Melee), Grenade/Rocket Launchers (Impact and Detonation damage count separately), Sniper Rifles
• 7 Hits: Scout Rifles
• 12 Hits: Sidearms
• 13 Hits: Submachine Guns
• 14 Hits: Fusion Rifles
• 16 Hits: Auto Rifles

I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.
Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.
My Taken Seekers can stun [overload]Overload Champions.
My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) take 100% increased tick damage.
I do not interact with Malfeasance or Wish-Ender.
**▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟****▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟**
Finishers with no active Armor Charge Stacks grant 1 Stack of Armor Charge.

Deals 50% increased damage to PvE Combatant Shields and 200% increased damage to [barrier]Barrier [Champion](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants) shields.
Melee Hits can discharge [Arc]Bolt Charge stacks.
Tapping [Heavy Attack] throws your blade up to 50 meters away, seeking up to 3 enemies before returning. Blade deals [pve]945 [pvp][174] damage to each target and 80% reduced damage while returning. Pressing [Light Attack] recalls the blade early.
Holding [Heavy Attack] throws your blade 20 meters forward in a straight unguided path and increases its damage by 100%.
**With Gyro Core Equipped:** Thrown Blade Hits apply elemental effects matching your subclass:
• [Arc] Grants x1 Bolt Charge
• [Solar] 35? Scorch (50? with [Solar]Ember of Ashes). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• [Void] Weakens for 6 seconds
• [Stasis] 50 Slow for 4 seconds (8 with [Stasis]Whisper of Durance). Stacks vary? between the two heavy attacks
• [Strand] Severs for 10 seconds (15 with [Strand]Thread of Continuity)
Fires two [Void]Void Bolts that heal on hit for 11 HP each.

Weapon Kills grant a Stack of 'Onslaught' for 4.5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.
Benefits at 1|2|3 Stacks of Onslaught:
• 16.7% | 28.6% | 37.5% decreased Firing Delay
• 15 | 25 | 35 Reload Speed

Grants the following to [Strand]Strand Weapons ~0.5 seconds after readying them:
• 10|15|18 Reload Speed with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

Grants the following to [Arc]Arc Weapons 1 second after readying them:
• 5|8|10 Aim Assist with 1|2|3 Mods equipped
• 0.9x|0.85x|0.8x Accuracy Cone Size
• 0.85x|0.75x|0.7x ADS Animation Duration Multiplier

Scoring a Precision Kill or 3 kills within 3 seconds of each other spawns a [Strand]Threadling at the target's location.
[enh] Spawns an additional hatchling every ? activations.

Spawns an Orb of Power upon scoring 2 Kills within ? seconds of each with a [Void]Void or [Strand]Strand Weapon.
Kills within 1 second of an activation do not count.
Spawned Orbs of Power grant 2.5%|3.25%|4.4% Super Energy with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.

Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for 15 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial 15-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

Passively grants 20 Airborne Effectiveness to [primary]Primary Weapons.
Grants the following benefits while a [primary]Primary Weapon is readied and not Aiming Down Sights:
• 30 Mobility
• 5 Range and 30? Stability
• 70% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 2 degrees increased Precision Aim Cone Angle
• 20% increased Aim Assist and Damage Falloff Distance
DMT, Last Word, and Tommy's Matchbook are uniquely tuned and do not receive as significant of a benefit.
[primary]Primary Weapon Kills grant Class Ability Energy based on [Enemy Rank](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants):
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 20%
Ability energy gained is NOT affected by Chunk Energy Scalars. Learn more about this mechanic in [our explainer blog post on the Clarity website](https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars).
At full Class Ability energy, scoring multiple [primary]Primary Weapon Kills within 6 seconds of each grants an additional Class Ability Charge. Maximum of 2 extra charges.
Activation progress granted by [Enemy Rank](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants):
Minors: 34% | Elites and higher: 100% | Players: 100%
Passively grants 10 Accuracy.

While within 15 meters of allies:
• Finishing a reload overfills the Magazine from reserves by 10% of the Base Magazine Capacity (rounded up) for each ally
• Bows receive 7.5%|15%|17.5%|20%|25% decreased Draw Time for 1|2|3|4|5+? allies
• Swords receive increased Charge Rate

Picking up an Ammo Brick causes the next shot fired to attach a Sticky Bomb on impact.
Sticky Bomb detonates after 0.8 seconds, dealing up to [enh][pve]410 [pvp][?] Kinetic Damage and Exhausting targets in 6 meter radius. Damage falls off to 50% at the edge of the radius.
Sticky Bombs inherit the weapon's [Combatant Damage Scaling](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatant-scaling).
[enh] Increases Sticky Bomb damage.

Deploying a Guidance Ring or Guidance Seeker Hits grants the following benefits for 5 seconds:
• 40% reduced Hip-Fire Accuracy Cone
• 50% decreased Draw Time
• 100 Reload Speed
• ?% decreased Reload Animation Duration

Precision Kills create a Large [Stasis]Stasis Crystal at the target's location.
[Tier 1-2 Minor and Tier 1 Elite](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants) Combatants only spawn a Medium [Stasis]Stasis Crystal.
Creating 5 [Stasis]Crystals within ? seconds prevents the perk from activating for 5 seconds.

Melee Kills start health regeneration.
While Transcendent, this also applies to allies within ? meters.

[Stasis]Freezing or [Void]Suppressing an enemy refills your readied weapon's magazine from reserves and grants 20? Stability, ? Aim Assist, and 40 Airborne Effectiveness for 11 seconds.
4 second cooldown between activations.
Killing [Stasis]Frozen or [Void]Suppressed Enemies spawns a [Stasis]Stasis Shard or [Void]Void Breach respectively.

Collecting Orbs of Power grants Elemental buffs based on your equipped Super's element:
• [Arc]Arc: 1 [Arc]Bolt Charge Stack
• [Solar]Solar: [Solar]Restoration x1 for 5 seconds
• [Void]Void: 22.5 HP [Void]Overshield for 5 seconds
• [Stasis]Stasis: 2 [Stasis]Frost Armor Stacks for 9 seconds
• [Strand]Strand: [Strand]Woven Mail for 5 seconds

[Solar]Ignitions have a 25% increased blast radius.
[Stasis]Shattering enemies or destroying [Stasis]Crystals creates an additional damage instance, dealing up to [pve]25 [pvp][9] damage in a [pve]10 [pvp][8] meter radius.
Damage falls off to [pve]17 [pvp][4] damage at the edge of the radius.

Grenade Ability Kills grant you [Solar]Cure x1.
Prismatic Grenade Kills grant you [Solar]Cure x2.

Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying a [Strand]Tangle grants additional Transcendence Energy of the matching alignment:
• [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches: 7.5% Light Transcendence Energy
• [Stasis]Stasis Shards: 5% Darkness Transcendence Energy
• [Strand]Tangles: 10% Darkness Transcendence Energy
Ability Kills with an active [Arc]Arc, [Solar]Solar, or [Void]Void Elemental buff grant an additional [pve]1% [pvp][?%] Darkness Transcendence Energy.

Grenade Kills grant [Void]Volatile Rounds to [Void]Void Weapons for [pve]11 [pvp][7.5] seconds.
Powered Melee Kills (including [Arc]Knockout) grant [Strand]Unraveling Rounds to [Strand]Strand Weapons for 11 [pvp][7.5] seconds.

[Void]Void Grenade Ability damage applies [Void]Weaken for [pve]6 [pvp][?] seconds.
[Arc]Arc Grenade Ability damage applies [Arc]Jolt.

Scoring a Super Kill or Killing 3 enemies with Elemental Damage within 6 seconds of each spawns an Elemental Pickup.
The type of Elemental Pickup is determined by the Damage Type of the final Kill.
5 second cooldown between spawning the same Pickup again. Spawned [Strand]Tangles share the 12 second global spawn cooldown with the Fragment.
Kills with the element of the spawned Pickup while the cooldown is active do not count towards spawning another Elemental Pickup.
Elemental Pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, [Strand]Tangles, and [Void]Void Breaches.

Precision Hits and Kills grant one stack of 'Dynamic Charge'. Maximum of 15 stacks.
Holding [Reload] refills the magazine based on the number of stacks and converts them into 'Revolution' stacks. Switching modes again removes all stacks.
Revolution stacks remain ready until fired, after which point they last 10 seconds. Arc Seekers gain [pve]30% [pvp][Varying] increased damage per stack of Revolution, up to 450% increased damage.
Arc Seekers also gain a non-linear increase to their splash radius, granting 33%|233% increased splash radius at x10|x20 Stacks (up to 4|7 meters in radius).
While Revolution's timer is active, Arc Seekers generate x2 [Arc]Bolt Charge for each hit and gain the ability to discharge [Arc]Bolt Charge stacks. At or above 10 stacks of Revolution, hits generate x3 [Arc]Bolt Charge.
[Arc]Bolt Charge generation is unaffected by [Arc]Spark of Frequency.
Review this exotic's intrinsic perk to learn a special note about the [Arc]Bolt Charge behavior from this gun.
Missing twice within 6 seconds refills 1 round into the Magazine from thin air.
Increases Reserves by 2 (14🠚16) and decreases Charge Time by 33% (1024🠚774) without reducing damage.

Powered Sword Hits grant 3% increased damage for [enh]4 seconds. Stacks 10 times for a 30% Buff.
Stowing the weapon or Blocking removes all stacks. Wolfpack Round Hits also count as Powered Sword Hits.
[enh] Buff duration is increased by 0.5 seconds.

Missing has a chance to refund 1 ammo into the magazine based on the ammo type:
• [primary]Primary Weapons: [enh]40%
• [special]Special and [heavy]Power Weapons: [enh]25%
[enh] Ammo Refund chance is increased by an additive 5%.

Scoring multiple Hits within 6 seconds of each fires a Tracking Rocket that matches the weapon's element.
Rockets deal [pve]22.4 [pvp][14] Impact and [pve]24 [pvp][15] Explosive damage on Hit and inherit the weapon's [Combatant Damage Scaling](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatant-scaling). On non-primary weapons, the Rockets receive an additional damage increase.
% of magazine capacity as Hits required and the additional damage increase by weapon archetype:
• Hand Cannons, Pulse Rifles, Submachine Guns: 45% Magazine Capacity \\ 0% increased damage (Baseline)
• Sniper Rifles: 50%? \\ 100%
• Grenade Launchers: 30% \\ 25%
• Machine Guns: 25% \\ 50%
• Fusion Rifles, Shotguns: ?% \\ 150%
1 second cooldown after activation before further Hits provide activation progress again.

Precision Kills cause targets to explode, dealing up to [pve]123.89 [pvp][95.3] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4.5-meter radius.
[enh] Increases detonation damage by 10%.
Deals 11% increased damage against Cabal enemies and pierces through Phalanx Shields and Cabal Shield Domes.

Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 4 stacks. (e.g. triple kill ⇒ 3 stacks)
'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for [enh]17 seconds at 2|3|4 stacks (1st stack does not exist). Timer only starts after firing.
Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial [enh]17-second duration.
Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.
[enh] Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.

[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy projectile attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

Increases damage against shielded targets:
• [enh]140% increase against PVE Combatant Overshields
• [enh]55% increase against PVE Combatant Elemental Shields and [barrier]Barrier Champion Shields
• [enh]22% increase against Player Overshields and for bodyshots against Players with [Strand]Woven Mail
Notable Combatant Overshields include Shadow Legion [Tech Pack](https://www.destinypedia.com/Tech_Pack) and Lucent Moth Overshields. They are indicated with a glowing outline around the targets as well as a small blue health bar under the normal one.
Does not buff the Splash/Explosive damage elements of other perks.
[enh] Damage Buff is increased: 125%⁠🠚⁠140%, 50%⁠🠚⁠55%, 20%⁠🠚⁠22?⁠%.

Sets the Magazine Size to 33, greatly exceeding that of any other fusion rifle.
▛ **...an energy cell pulling from multiple timelines, resulting in a charge surplus that can only be explained if the firing cycle began in...** ▟

Requires a [Stasis]Stasis Super Ability to be equipped. Overwrites Barricade Cooldown to Pre-EoF values, resulting in ~1.45x faster Base Class Ability Regeneration.
Scoring 2 [Stasis]Stasis Kills within 3 seconds of each grants a Stack of [Stasis]Frost Armor.
Restores 10 HP for each Stack of [Stasis]Frost Armor you gain from any source.
Replaces Barricade with Glacial Guard which has a cooldown matching Towering Barricade's. Does not work with [Arc]Thruster.
On Glacial Guard Cast:
• Grants you maximum [Stasis]Frost Armor Stacks (restoring HP for each Stack gained)
• Applies [pve]100 [pvp][40] [Stasis]Slow to enemies within ? meters

Glaive Melee Kills load 1 Ammo into the Magazine from reserves. Can overfill the Magazine up to double the normal capacity.
While within 15 meters of 3 enemies:
Grants 50 Reload Speed and 200% increased Glaive Melee Damage.
Glaive Projectile Kills cause enemies to explode, dealing up to [pve]350 [pvp][101] weapon-matching elemental damage in a 4? meter radius.

Sliding refills 15% of the Magazine (rounded up) and grants [enh]22 Range and Stability for your next shot (of the burst) within 2.5 seconds.
0.3 second cooldown after activation but can activate multiple times during a slide. Buff is removed on stow.
[enh] Stat bonuses are increased by 2?.

Grants the following benefits if you have not dealt or received damage in the last 5 seconds:
• 20 Range and 20 Handling
• 15% decreased Draw Time on Bows
• 10.78% increased damage against PvE Combatants. Linear Fusion Rifles only receive an 8.88% damage increase.
Deactivates 2 seconds after exchanging damage.

Grants a 0.8x|0.75x|0.7x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier to [Stasis]Stasis Weapons with 1|2|3 Mods equipped.
Stow Animation Duration cannot be decreased below what it would be at 100 Handling.

Aiming Down Sights for 1.5 seconds without firing causes your next kill to trigger an explosion matching the weapon's element within an 8 meter radius, experiencing a maximum of 30% damage falloff.
Timer starts as soon as ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

Precision Kills grant 'Lightning Rod'.
Lightning Rod arrows explode on impact and chain lightning in an 8 meter radius around their point of impact for [pve]194 [pvp][50.3] damage each.

Precision Hits decrease Draw Time by 25% for 3 seconds.
Buff is removed on stow.

Refills Magazine from reserves upon dropping to 30% Shield Health. Can activate while stowed.
Grants 50 Handling and a 0.95x Ready/Stow Animation Duration Multiplier while at or below 30% Shield Health.
Buff lingers for 1 second once the condition is no longer met.

On kill or Precision Hit, gain one stack of Paracausal Charge. Maximum of 7 stacks. Stacks are removed on reload or any full magazine refill.
Paracausal Charge grants increased damage against Combatants at 1|2|3|....|7| Stacks:
[pve]21%|36.5%|48%|55%|60%|63%|66%
Paracausal Charge turns into Paracausal Shot on the final round of the magazine. Buff is removed if stowed.
Paracausal Shot's damage bonus at 1|2|3|...|7| stacks:
[pve]PvE: 292%|300%|340%|425%|667%|1071%|1736%
[pvp]PvP: 30%|33%|46%|80.5%|154%|288%|509%

Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on [Combatant Rank](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants). Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously.
Charge progress from kills:
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3
At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits [Strand]Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.
Snareweaver traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire take [pve]341 [pvp][5] damage and are [Strand]Suspended. Each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.
5 second cooldown between [Strand]Suspends on the same enemy.
[Strand]Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with [Strand]Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against [Minibosses](https://url.d2clarity.com/combatants).
This weapon fires a small auto-tracking missile. Missiles lock onto targets when aimed.

Rounds must be chambered after every shot. Animation can be sprint-cancelled as soon as the bolt is drawn in (at the 'clink'), allowing for an increased rate of fire.

[Arc]Bolt Charge that is discharged through [Arc]Arc Seeker hits counts as 'Scout Rifle Weapon Damage' and benefits from all increases that apply to this damage type. This allows the [Arc]Bolt Charge detonations to scale both with traditional weapon damage buffs (like [Solar]Radiant and Surges) and with Combatant Scalars.
Furthermore, hits that would discharge [Arc]Bolt Charge anyway (such as hits behind a [Arc]Storm's Keep barricade or hits as the caster of a [Solar]Well of Radiance) cause [Arc]Bolt Charge to discharge twice, with one buffed as weapon damage and the other being a regular discharge.
This damage increase to [Arc]Bolt Charge can be further compounded by the Flashover Artifact Mod from the Tablet of Ruin, which adds a multiplicative 50%.
